name: ActivityGrid
summary: A year of days, as a grid you can read at a glance.

props.name: days
props.description: The days to draw, as `YYYY-MM-DD`, oldest first.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the grid, e.g. "Your year". Already translated.

props.name: levelFor
props.description: A class for one day's square, e.g. `bg-positive/40`.

props.name: dayLabel
props.description: What a reader hears on a day: the date, and what happened. Translated.

props.name: isSelectable
props.description: Which days lead somewhere. Unset, the grid is a picture and nothing else.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: `1` Monday, `0` Sunday.

props.name: startAtEnd
props.description: Open on the most recent weeks — a year otherwise starts far off-screen.

name: AuthForm
summary: The sign-in and sign-up forms, which are one component.

props.name: labels
props.description: Every string on screen. No defaults, in any language: a label the kit invented would ship English into an app that has none, and it would do it silently.

props.name: busy
props.description: Disables the controls and spins the submit button.

props.name: error
props.description: A failure to show above the submit button, already translated. A sentence rather than a key, because the kit cannot translate and `toAuthMessageKey` hands the caller a key precisely so the caller can.

props.name: validate
props.description: Returns one message per invalid field, or null when the values are good. Omitted, the form submits whatever is typed and lets the server decide — which is a legitimate choice, not a broken one. `fieldErrors` turns a Zod schema into this in one line.

name: AuthShell
summary: The frame every sign-in screen sits in.

name: AvatarStack
summary: The people on a thing, overlapped: who is in a conversation, who shares a list.

props.name: people
props.type: readonly { name: string; src?: string | undefined }[]
props.description: Each person's name, and a picture where there is one.

props.name: label
props.description: The stack's accessible name: "Shared with 6 people". Already translated.

props.name: max
props.description: How many faces before the rest become a number.

name: BaseAccordion
summary: A list that opens one section at a time.

props.name: multiple
props.description: Allow several open at once. Off by default, which is what makes it an accordion.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Which heading the control sits inside. A heading, always — it is how a screen reader user moves between sections without opening any of them. The level is a prop because it depends on what is above it on the page, and getting it wrong breaks the outline.

name: BaseAlert
summary: A message the reader has to take in before carrying on.

props.name: assertive
props.description: Announce immediately, interrupting. For failures the reader must act on.

name: BaseAvatar
summary: The person, in the corner where the account lives.

props.name: name
props.description: Used for the initials and, failing a `label`, as the accessible name.

props.name: label
props.description: Overrides the accessible name. For "Your account" rather than a person's name.

name: BaseBadge
summary: A small standing label: a level, a state, a count.

name: BaseBreadcrumb
summary: Where this page sits, and the way back up.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the landmark.

name: BaseButton
summary: The kit's button, and — when asked — its link.

props.name: as
props.description: What to render. `button` unless this navigates.

props.name: variant
props.description: `link` is a real action that should read as text — "clear this note", "remove", "change category". It has no surface at all, so it also has no height and no padding: giving it either would make it a ghost button, which is a different thing and was already here.

props.name: size
props.description: `xs` is the action inside a prompt or a nudge, not on a page.

props.name: type
props.description: Ignored unless `as` is `button`.

props.name: icon
props.description: Square, sized to its icon, with no label beside it. **Pass `aria-label`.** An icon on its own has no accessible name, and a control a screen reader announces as "button" is not usable. Attributes fall through, so `aria-label` lands where it should — nothing here can check that you passed one, which is why it is said this loudly.

props.name: block
props.description: Fills its container. The ordinary case under a form.

props.name: to
props.description: For `as="router-link"`.

props.name: href
props.description: For `as="a"`.

props.name: pill
props.description: Fully rounded rather than card-cornered. Every install prompt, update prompt and nudge across the apps used the same pair — a filled pill to act and a quiet one to dismiss — and none of them could use this component, because it only knew one corner radius.

props.name: pressed
props.description: That this button is a switch, and whether it is on. Omit it and the button is an action. Pass it and the button becomes a toggle: `aria-pressed` is written, and the variants that have an "off" look — ghost, quiet, secondary — take a filled one when on. There were 18 of these hand-written across the three apps, every one a picker cell or a filter chip, and almost none of them said `aria-pressed` at all. A screen reader met a row of identical buttons with no way to know which was chosen.

name: BaseCalendar
summary: A month of days, for choosing one or a stretch of them.

props.name: mode
props.description: One day, or a stretch from one day to another.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day that can be chosen, as `YYYY-MM-DD`.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Days to rule out inside the range — weekends, days already booked.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: `1` Monday, `0` Sunday.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the back arrow, e.g. "Previous month".

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the forward arrow.

props.name: today
props.description: Which day is marked as today. Given, so a test or a demo can fix it.

name: BaseCard
summary: A surface with a border, and optionally a head and a foot.

props.name: padding
props.description: How much room the card gives its contents. This component shipped with `px-5 py-4` baked in and was then used by nobody, across three apps and thirty-five hand-written card surfaces — which used `p-3` six times, `p-4` six times, `p-5` five times and `p-1` four times, and not once the pair this insisted on. A card that fixes its padding cannot be reached for, which is the same mistake `PageContainer` made with its width and `size="sm"` made with its height. `none` is for a card that holds a list: the rows own the padding, and the dividers have to reach the border.

name: BaseCheckbox
summary: A single checkbox, with its label beside it.

props.name: size
props.description: `md` is a setting: a line the reader came here to change, in ink. `sm` is an aside — "remember me" under a sign-in form, "show the ones I have learned" above a list — quieter and tighter. The two are not a guess. Of the five hand-written checkboxes across the three consuming apps, four were the aside and one was the setting, and they differed in exactly these two ways.

name: BaseChip
summary: A short label with, when it is one of a set someone assembled, a way to take it off: a filter, a recipient, a tag.

props.name: label
props.description: The text. Already translated.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Given, the chip grows a remove button. Its accessible name.

props.name: selected
props.description: Given, the whole chip is a toggle and this is its state.

name: BaseCombobox
summary: A field you type into to narrow a list, then choose from it.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The chosen value, or values in `multiple` mode, with `v-model`.

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when nothing matches. Already translated.

props.name: mode
props.description: `multiple` keeps the chosen ones as chips in the field.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Names a chip's remove button. Without it, chips carry no button.

props.name: loading
props.description: Marks the list busy while an answer is on its way.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Read while `loading`. Already translated.

props.name: filter
props.description: `none` when the server has already narrowed the list.

props.name: debounce
props.description: How long typing settles before `search`, in milliseconds.

props.name: virtualizeAfter
props.description: Past this many options, only the rows near the viewport are rendered.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: A row's height in pixels; the virtual window is measured in these.

name: BaseContextMenu
summary: The menu a right-click opens, on whatever it was opened over.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the menu for a screen reader. Already translated.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Leaves the browser's own menu alone — for a text field, or a link.

name: BaseDatePicker
summary: A date, or a stretch of dates, chosen from a calendar in a popover.

props.name: mode
props.description: One day, or a stretch from one day to another.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: What the field shows while nothing is chosen.

props.name: format
props.description: How the chosen date reads, through `Intl.DateTimeFormat`.

props.name: presets
props.description: Ready-made answers beside the calendar: "Last 7 days", "This month".

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Given, the field grows a button that empties it. Its accessible name.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the calendar's back arrow.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the calendar's forward arrow.

props.name: today
props.description: Which day the calendar marks as today. Given, so a demo or a test can fix it.

name: BaseDisclosure
summary: One section that opens and closes.

props.name: title
props.description: The question. Already translated. Optional only because the `title` slot is the other way to give one — pass exactly one of them. A disclosure with neither has a control nobody can read, which is why this is documented rather than defaulted to something.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Which heading the control sits inside. A heading, always — it is how a screen reader user moves between sections without opening any of them. The level depends on what is above it on the page, and getting it wrong breaks the outline.

name: BaseDrawer
summary: A panel that comes in from the edge of a wide screen.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the dialog. Already translated.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button. Already translated.

props.name: side
props.description: Which edge it comes from. `start` and `end` follow the writing direction.

props.name: size
props.description: How far it reaches in from that edge — a width on the sides, a height on the top and bottom. Any CSS length.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Escape and the scrim close it. Off for something half filled in.

name: BaseHoverCard
summary: A card that appears beside something when you rest on it.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the card for a screen reader. Already translated.

props.name: openDelay
props.description: How long a pointer has to rest before it opens, in ms.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: How long it survives the pointer leaving, so the card can be reached.

name: BaseInput
summary: A text field with its label, hint and error already wired to it.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The value, with `v-model`. Its type is whatever you bind.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: Hides the label visually but keeps it for assistive tech. For fields whose surrounding row already names them — dropping the label entirely would leave the input with no accessible name at all.

props.name: type
props.description: Every type a text field can be, because the ones missing were the ones apps needed: `date` and `search` were hand-written three times each and `url` twice, in files that already imported this component.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` for a field inside a row rather than in a form of its own.

props.name: variant
props.description: `unstyled` keeps the wiring and drops the surface. The label, the generated id, `aria-describedby` and the error are what a field is; the border and the height are what it looks like. A search box inside a bordered row, a url field in an editor popover — those places were hand-writing the whole thing to avoid the appearance, and losing the wiring with it. The same reasoning as `BaseButton`'s `unstyled`, and the same test: a primitive is finished when the app can take its behaviour without its paint.

name: BaseKbd
summary: A keyboard key, or a chord of them: `⌘ K`, `Ctrl Shift P`.

props.name: keys
props.description: One key, or the keys of a chord: `['⌘', 'K']`.

props.name: joiner
props.description: Drawn between the keys — "+", "then". Empty, they simply sit apart.

name: BaseLink
summary: A link in a sentence — the one thing a button is not.

props.name: to
props.description: A route. Uses `RouterLink`, so the app needs vue-router.

props.name: href
props.description: A URL. Anything not on this site should be `external`.

props.name: external
props.description: Opens in a new tab, with the mark and the `rel` that belong to that.

name: BaseListbox
summary: A list you choose from, open on the page.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The chosen option, or options, with `v-model`.

props.name: label
props.description: The list's accessible name.

props.name: mode
props.description: One option, or any number of them.

props.name: height
props.description: How tall before it scrolls. Any CSS length.

name: BaseMarquee
summary: A row that scrolls sideways without end: logos, testimonials, a ticker.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full pass. Longer is slower; the speed does not change with the content's length.

props.name: reverse
props.description: Move left to right instead.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds it still.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fade the content out at both edges instead of cutting it.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between items, and between the end of one pass and the start of the next. Any CSS length.

name: BaseMenu
summary: A list of actions behind one control.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the trigger. Required: the trigger is usually a glyph.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge the panel lines up with.

name: BaseModal
summary: A dialog that arrives from nowhere.

props.name: title
props.description: Names the dialog for assistive tech. Required; an unnamed dialog is a box.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the close button.

props.name: tone
props.description: `alert` marks it as a decision that interrupts — `role="alertdialog"`, which a screen reader announces immediately rather than on arrival.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether Escape and the backdrop close it. Off for a dialog that must be answered — but never off as a way of forcing a reader to a decision they have not been given the information for.

name: BasePagination
summary: Moving between pages of a list.

props.name: page
props.description: Current page, 1-based.

props.name: pages
props.description: How many there are.

props.name: siblings
props.description: How many numbers to show either side of the current one.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the landmark.

props.name: previousLabel
props.description: Names for the arrows, already translated. Required, because `‹` is a glyph and not a word: a screen reader reading the arrow announces nothing a person can act on.

name: BasePopconfirm
summary: "Are you sure?", asked beside the button that asked it.

props.name: message
props.description: The question. Already translated.

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: The button that goes ahead, e.g. "Delete".

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: The button that does not, e.g. "Cancel".

props.name: title
props.description: A heading over the question, and the panel's accessible name.

props.name: tone
props.description: The confirming button's variant.

name: BasePopover
summary: A panel of anything — a form, a picker, a few settings — anchored to the control that opened it.

props.name: label
props.description: The panel's accessible name — what a screen reader announces on open.

props.name: side
props.description: Where it prefers to open. It flips when there is no room there.

props.name: align
props.description: Which edge of the trigger the panel lines up with.

name: BaseRadioGroup
summary: A set of radios, and the reason there is no `BaseRadio`.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The chosen option's value, with `v-model`.

props.name: options
props.type: readonly { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean | undefined }[]

name: BaseRating
summary: A score out of five, given or shown.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being rated: "Difficulty", "Your rating". Already translated.

props.name: valueLabel
props.description: The spoken value: `(value, max) => \`${value} out of ${max}\`.`

props.name: readonly
props.description: Shows a score rather than asks for one.

props.name: allowClear
props.description: Pressing the current score again clears it.

name: BaseReveal
summary: Content that fades or rises into place as it scrolls into view.

props.name: effect
props.description: How it arrives: fading in, rising a little as it does, or growing to size.

props.name: delay
props.description: Milliseconds to wait once it is in view — the stagger in a list.

props.name: once
props.description: Reveal once and stay. Off, it hides again each time it leaves the screen.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render.

name: BaseSelect
summary: A native `<select>`, wearing the kit's field.

props.name: options
props.type: readonly { value: T; label: string; disabled?: boolean | undefined }[]

props.name: placeholder
props.description: An unselectable first row, for a field with no sensible default. Disabled rather than merely empty: an empty option that can be chosen lets someone go back to having answered nothing, which no form wants.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` for a select that filters or sorts rather than answers a form. Every hand-written select across the three consuming apps was this one.

props.name: variant
props.description: `unstyled` keeps the wiring and drops the surface. The label, the generated id, `aria-describedby` and the error are what a field is; the border and the height are what it looks like. A search box inside a bordered row, a url field in an editor popover — those places were hand-writing the whole thing to avoid the appearance, and losing the wiring with it. The same reasoning as `BaseButton`'s `unstyled`, and the same test: a primitive is finished when the app can take its behaviour without its paint.

name: BaseSeparator
summary: A line between things — with, when it helps, a word on it.

props.name: label
props.description: A word in the middle of the line: "or", "Today". Already translated.

props.name: spacing
props.description: Room around it. `none` for a divider inside a list that has its own.

name: BaseSheet
summary: Pins the sheet to the area the keyboard has left visible.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the close button. A prop rather than a translation: a component that calls t() forces every consumer onto one i18n setup, and this is the package's only visible string.

name: BaseSkeleton
summary: One grey box standing in for content that has not arrived.

props.name: width
props.description: Any CSS length: `12rem`, `60%`, `8ch`.

props.name: shape
props.description: `circle` makes a round one and squares the width to the height.

name: BaseSlider
summary: A value picked from a range, where roughly right is the point.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns the number into something a person would say — "45 minutes", "₺12". Used for the visible readout and for `aria-valuetext`, so both say the same thing and neither is a bare number.

name: BaseSpinner
summary: Work in progress, with no idea how much is left.

props.name: label
props.description: What is being waited for. Already translated.

name: BaseSplitter
summary: Two panes and a handle between them — a list beside a preview, an editor beside its output.

props.name: label
props.description: The handle's accessible name, e.g. "Resize the list".

props.name: orientation
props.description: `horizontal`: side by side, the handle moves left and right.

props.name: min
props.description: How small the first pane may get, as a percentage.

props.name: step
props.description: How far one arrow press moves it, in percentage points.

name: BaseStepper
summary: Where someone is in a process of several steps — a sign-up, a checkout, a form split into pages.

props.name: label
props.description: The list's accessible name, e.g. "Checkout".

props.name: interactive
props.description: Completed steps become buttons that go back to them.

props.name: stateLabels
props.description: Read to a screen reader after a step's label: `{ complete: 'done', error: 'needs attention' }`.

name: BaseSwitch
summary: A setting that takes effect the moment it is touched.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: For a switch inside a row that already names it — it keeps its accessible name.

name: BaseTable
summary: Rows of data, with the parts a hand-written `<table>` leaves out.

props.name: caption
props.description: What this table is. Required — an unnamed table is a box of numbers.

props.name: captionHidden
props.description: Keeps the caption for assistive tech when the page already shows a heading.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Which field identifies a row. Falls back to the index.

name: BaseTabs
summary: Sections of one page, one visible at a time.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the tablist.

name: BaseTextarea
summary: A multi-line field.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The text, with `v-model`.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` tightens the label and the spacing. It does **not** shrink the text: iOS zooms the viewport when it focuses a field under 16px and never zooms back, which is why both phone apps force 16px on form elements in their base layer.

props.name: variant
props.description: `unstyled` keeps the wiring and drops the surface. The label, the generated id, `aria-describedby` and the error are what a field is; the border and the height are what it looks like. A search box inside a bordered row, a url field in an editor popover — those places were hand-writing the whole thing to avoid the appearance, and losing the wiring with it. The same reasoning as `BaseButton`'s `unstyled`, and the same test: a primitive is finished when the app can take its behaviour without its paint.

name: BaseTimeline
summary: What happened, in order, on a rail.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the list. Already translated.

name: BaseToolbar
summary: A row of controls that belong together: a formatting bar, a row of view switches, the actions over a table.

props.name: label
props.description: The toolbar's accessible name, e.g. "Formatting".

name: BaseTooltip
summary: A short label that appears beside a control.

props.name: label
props.description: The description. Already translated.

props.name: follow
props.description: Track the pointer across the trigger instead of pinning to its middle.

props.name: offset
props.description: How far the bubble sits from the pointer, in pixels.

name: BaseTree
summary: A tree of things that contain things: folders, a category list, a table of contents.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The chosen key, or keys in `multiple` mode, with `v-model`.

props.name: label
props.description: The tree's accessible name.

props.name: mode
props.description: `multiple` lets several be chosen, each with its own tick.

name: CircularProgress
summary: Progress as a ring — for a small space, a card's corner, a goal.

props.name: value
props.description: How far. Leave it out while there is nothing to measure.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name, e.g. "Upload". Required: a ring says nothing aloud on its own.

props.name: showValue
props.description: The rounded percentage inside the ring.

name: CodeBlock
summary: A sample of code, as written.

props.name: code
props.description: The sample itself. Shown exactly as given.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the block, e.g. "Installing the package". Required because this is a region a reader can land in, and an unnamed one is announced as nothing at all.

props.name: language
props.description: Shown in the corner, e.g. `bash`, `ts`. Not used to highlight anything.

props.name: wrap
props.description: Break long lines instead of scrolling sideways.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: Given together with `copiedLabel`, adds a copy button. Already translated.

name: ColorPicker
summary: A colour, as a hex value.

props.name: label
props.description: Names the control. Already translated.

props.name: modelValue
props.description: The colour, as `#rrggbb`. Required: a picker with no colour shows none.

props.name: swatches
props.description: Colours to offer beside the picker. The app's values and names.

props.name: hexLabel
props.description: Names the hex field. Without it, there is no hex field.

name: CommandMenu
summary: Everything the app can do, behind one shortcut.

props.name: label
props.description: The dialog's accessible name, e.g. "Commands".

props.name: placeholder
props.description: The field's placeholder, e.g. "Type a command or search".

props.name: emptyLabel
props.description: Shown when nothing matches, e.g. "Nothing found".

props.name: hotkey
props.description: The letter that opens it with ⌘ or Ctrl. Unset, the app opens it itself.

name: CopyButton
summary: Copies a piece of text, and says that it did.

props.name: text
props.description: What lands on the clipboard.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: The button's name at rest, e.g. "Copy the key".

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Its name for the two seconds after, e.g. "Copied".

props.name: errorLabel
props.description: Said when the browser refuses. Unset, a refusal only leaves it unchanged.

props.name: withText
props.description: Show the label beside the icon, rather than only to assistive tech.

name: CountUp
summary: A number that counts up to its value once it scrolls into view.

props.name: value
props.description: The number to count to. Change it and it counts on from where it is.

props.name: from
props.description: Where the first count starts.

props.name: duration
props.description: How long a count takes, in milliseconds.

props.name: format
props.description: Passed to `Intl.NumberFormat`. Set `maximumFractionDigits` to count in decimals.

props.name: locale
props.description: A BCP 47 tag. Unset, the kit's active formatting locale.

name: DataTable
summary: `BaseTable` with the three things a table of real data grows: a sort, a selection, and something to show while it is loading.

props.name: caption
props.description: What this table is. Required — an unnamed table is a box of numbers.

props.name: rowKey
props.description: Which field identifies a row. Required for selection.

props.name: selectAllLabel
props.description: Given with `rowKey`, the table grows a checkbox column. Names the header one.

props.name: rowLabel
props.description: Names each row's checkbox from the row: `(row) => \`Select ${row.name}\``.

props.name: manualSort
props.description: Report the sort instead of doing it — for a server that pages the data.

props.name: loading
props.description: Draws skeleton rows instead of the body.

props.name: stickyHeader
props.description: Keeps the header on screen while the body scrolls under it.

name: DescriptionList
summary: Pairs of "what it is" and "what it says": the summary at the top of a detail page, the facts under an invoice.

props.name: layout
props.description: `inline` puts the term beside its value; `stacked` puts it above.

name: EmptyState
summary: A list with nothing in it yet, said kindly.

name: ErrorBoundary
summary: Keeps one broken screen from taking the whole app down.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Clears the error whenever it changes — a route path, usually. An error on one screen should not follow somebody to the next one, and without this the boundary stays broken until a full reload.

name: FabButton
summary: The one action the app is built around, reachable from every screen.

props.name: label
props.description: The words beside the icon.

name: FileDrop
summary: Files, dropped on or chosen from a real file input.

props.name: label
props.description: The instruction in the box: "Drop a receipt here". Already translated.

props.name: hint
props.description: A line under it: what is accepted, how big.

props.name: browseLabel
props.description: The button inside the box, e.g. "Browse".

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of each file's remove button.

props.name: accept
props.description: Passed to the input: `image/*`, `.pdf`.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: In bytes. Anything larger is refused and reported through `rejected`.

props.name: tooLargeLabel
props.description: Shown under the box when a file was too large.

name: FormField
summary: A label, a hint, an error, and the wiring between them.

props.name: size
props.description: `sm` for a control that sits inside something else — a toolbar, a filter row, a settings line — rather than in a form of its own. It exists because every hand-written select in all three apps was the small one, and the kit only had the large one. A part is not reusable if reaching for it costs a size somebody chose on purpose.

props.name: labelHidden
props.description: Hides the label visually but keeps it for assistive tech. For fields whose surrounding row already names them — dropping the label entirely would leave the control with no accessible name at all.

name: GoogleButton
summary: Sign in with Google, in Google's own clothes.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Greyed out and unclickable while a sign-in is already in flight. A real prop rather than a fallthrough attribute: the button needs to look disabled as well as be it, and a bare `disabled` landing on the element by itself gets the second half only.

name: InstallPrompt
summary: The card that offers to install the app, and remembers being turned down.

props.name: storageKey
props.description: Where the dismissal is remembered. Namespace it: `hibi-install-nudge`.

props.name: action
props.description: The install button. Not shown on iOS, which has no API to call.

props.name: iosTitle
props.description: Shown instead of `title` where the user has to use the Share menu.

name: InstallSettings
summary: The way back to installing after the card has been dismissed.

props.name: title
props.description: The group's heading.

props.name: label
props.description: The row's label while installing is still possible.

props.name: installedLabel
props.description: The row's label once it is installed.

props.name: iosBody
props.description: Shown instead of `body` on iOS, where the user must use the Share menu.

props.name: action
props.description: The install button. Absent on iOS, which has no API to call.

name: LocaleLinks
summary: A flat language switcher for screens with no Settings behind them.

props.name: labels
props.description: Endonyms, e.g. `{ en: 'English', tr: 'Türkçe' }`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group.

name: LocaleSheet
summary: Choosing the interface language, from a settings row.

props.name: label
props.description: The settings row's label, and the sheet's title.

props.name: systemLabel
props.description: What "follow the device" is called. Its value is `system`.

props.name: options
props.description: In the order they should be listed. Labels are endonyms.

name: MegaMenu
summary: A wide site's navigation, where a section has more in it than a row can hold: columns of links under a heading, opened from the bar.

props.name: active
props.description: Which section is current. Usually derived from the route.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark.

props.name: openOnHover
props.description: Whether a pointer opens a panel as well as a click.

props.name: hoverDelay
props.description: How long the pointer has to leave before the panel closes, in ms.

name: NavLinks
summary: The primary navigation of a wide site.

props.name: active
props.description: Which item is current. Usually derived from the route.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark.

name: NumberInput
summary: A number, typed or stepped — a quantity, a price, a count of minutes.

props.name: step
props.description: One press of a button or an arrow key. Its decimals set the rounding.

props.name: decrementLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the minus button, e.g. "Decrease".

props.name: incrementLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the plus button, e.g. "Increase".

name: NumberTicker
summary: A number whose digits roll to their new value, like an odometer or a note counter.

props.name: value
props.description: The number to show. Change it and the digits roll to the new one.

props.name: from
props.description: Where the digits start when the component mounts, so a count can roll up as the page opens. Unset, the first frame is already the value.

props.name: format
props.description: Passed to `Intl.NumberFormat`: `{ style: 'currency', currency: 'TRY' }`, decimals, grouping.

props.name: locale
props.description: A BCP 47 tag. Unset, the kit's active formatting locale.

name: OfflineBanner
summary: A floating note that the connection has gone.

props.name: label
props.description: The message. Required, because the kit has no language of its own.

name: PageContainer
summary: One measure, centred, with the page's gutters.

props.name: width
props.description: `wide` for a page, `reading` for prose, `full` to opt out.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render. `main`, `section` and `article` all belong here.

name: PageHeader
summary: The bar at the top of a screen: a title with room either side of it.

name: PinInput
summary: A short code typed one character per box — a sign-in code, a PIN.

props.name: length
props.description: How many characters.

props.name: label
props.description: The group's accessible name, e.g. "Verification code".

props.name: cellLabel
props.description: Each box's accessible name, from its 1-based position: `(n, total) => \`Digit ${n} of ${total}\``.

props.name: type
props.description: `numeric` takes digits and opens the number pad; `alphanumeric` takes letters too.

props.name: mask
props.description: Show dots instead of the characters, for a PIN.

props.name: error
props.description: A message under the boxes; also marks them invalid.

name: PriceCard
summary: One plan in a pricing table.

props.name: price
props.description: Already formatted, or whatever stands in while there is no price.

props.name: badge
props.description: Rides on the card's edge, e.g. "Recommended".

props.name: chip
props.description: Sits inside, e.g. "30% cheaper" or "Your plan".

props.name: recommended
props.description: Raises the card and lets the badge show.

name: ProgressBar
summary: How far through something somebody is.

props.name: size
props.description: How thick the track is. `sm` for a bar under a step counter, where it is a hint rather than the subject; `lg` where the progress is the point. It shipped at one thickness and the two bars anybody wanted were `h-1`.

props.name: label
props.description: For screen readers. Without it this is a rectangle that means nothing.

name: ResponsiveDialog
summary: One question, asked the way the screen it lands on expects: a modal on a wide screen, a sheet from the bottom edge on a phone.

props.name: title
props.description: The dialog's heading, and its accessible name. Already translated.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the close button.

props.name: subtitle
props.description: A line under the title, on the sheet.

props.name: tone
props.description: `alert` makes the wide one an `alertdialog`: an answer is required.

props.name: breakpoint
props.description: Where it turns from a sheet into a modal. Any media width.

name: SectionHeading
summary: A pill heading for a group of things.

props.name: count
props.description: Hidden when zero, so an empty group's heading stays quiet.

name: SegmentedControl
summary: A row of mutually exclusive choices.

name: SettingsGroup
summary: A titled run of settings rows.

name: SettingsRow
summary: One line in a settings card.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Renders the row as a button with a chevron.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Puts the control on its own line below the label, for wide controls.

name: SkeletonList
summary: A length starts with a digit, a dot, or opens a CSS function.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: How tall each row is, as either a utility class (`h-20`) or a CSS length (`5rem`, `72px`, `var(--row)`). Both are accepted because the class-only version failed silently: a length passed here landed in `class` as `5rem`, which is not a class, so the rows had no height and the placeholder rendered as nothing at all. A loading state that shows an empty page is worse than no loading state, because it looks like the page is finished and empty.

name: SliderField
summary: One number, reached either way: dragged along a range or typed exactly.

props.name: label
props.description: Names both controls. Already translated.

props.name: decrementLabel
props.description: Names the number field's step-down button. Already translated.

props.name: incrementLabel
props.description: Names the number field's step-up button. Already translated.

props.name: format
props.description: Turns the number into something a person would say — "45 minutes", "₺12". The slider's readout is the number field here, so this is only what a screen reader hears for the slider: `aria-valuetext`, which without it is a bare number and a bare number is not an answer to anything.

name: StatCard
summary: One number, with what it means and which way it is going.

name: TabBar
summary: The floating bottom bar.

props.name: active
props.description: Which item is current. Usually from `route.meta`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the navigation landmark.

name: TabShell
summary: The phone frame the whole app sits inside.

name: TagsInput
summary: A field that holds several short values: recipients, labels, skills.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: `(tag) => \`Remove ${tag}\`` — already translated.

props.name: max
props.description: How many tags at most. The field stops taking them at the limit.

props.name: allowDuplicates
props.description: By default the same tag twice is ignored.

name: TextRotate
summary: One word in a sentence that changes on its own: "Build it *glass*", then *brutal*, then *soft*.

props.name: words
props.description: The words, in order. The first is the one a server and a still page show.

props.name: interval
props.description: How long each word stays, in milliseconds.

props.name: paused
props.description: Holds the current word. For a pause button, or a section out of view.

name: TimePicker
summary: A time of day, chosen from two columns.

props.name: hoursLabel
props.description: The hour column's accessible name, e.g. "Hour".

props.name: minutesLabel
props.description: The minute column's accessible name.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: What the field shows while nothing is chosen.

props.name: step
props.description: Minutes between the choices in the second column.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest time that can be chosen, as `HH:mm`.

name: ToastHost
summary: Where the toasts land. One of these, at the app root.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: The accessible name of each dismiss button. Required, because the button is an X and an X has no name — and the kit does not know the language.

props.name: bottom
props.description: Stack from the bottom instead of the top. For a phone shell, where the top is a status bar and a header and the thumb is nowhere near it.

name: ToggleGroup
summary: A row of buttons that stay pressed — one at a time, or several at once.

props.name: options
props.type: readonly { value: V /** Visible text — or, with an icon and `iconOnly`, the accessible name. */ label: string icon?: Component | undefined /** Show the icon alone. The label becomes the button's accessible name. */ iconOnly?: boolean | undefined disabled?: boolean | undefined }[]

props.name: label
props.description: The group's accessible name.

props.name: mode
props.description: `single`: at most one pressed. `multiple`: any number.

props.name: required
props.description: In `single` mode, never let the last pressed button go.

name: ToneDot
summary: A small coloured dot, optionally labelled.

props.name: fill
props.description: Background utility for the dot, e.g. `bg-positive`.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional text after the dot. Omit for a bare marker.

name: TourShell
summary: The frame an onboarding guide runs inside.

props.name: index
props.description: Which slide, zero-based.

props.name: dialogLabel
props.description: The dialog's accessible name.

props.name: lastLabel
props.description: The button on the final slide — "Start", rather than "Next".

props.name: stepLabel
props.description: Names one segment for a screen reader, e.g. `(n) => \`Step ${n} of ${total}\``.

props.name: teleportTo
props.description: Where the dialog goes. A phone shell clips its children, so the guide has to leave the tree to cover the tab bar and the header alike.

name: TransferList
summary: Two lists and the way between them: what is available, what is chosen.

props.name: availableLabel
props.description: Heading over the left list, e.g. "Available". Already translated.

props.name: chosenLabel
props.description: Heading over the right list.

props.name: addLabel
props.description: The → button's accessible name, e.g. "Add the chosen ones".

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: The ← button's accessible name.

name: TypeWriter
summary: Text that types itself out, and — given several lines — deletes each one and types the next.

props.name: text
props.description: One line to type, or several to type in turn.

props.name: speed
props.description: Milliseconds per character typed.

props.name: deleteSpeed
props.description: Milliseconds per character deleted.

props.name: hold
props.description: How long a finished line stays before it is deleted, in milliseconds.

props.name: loop
props.description: With several lines, start again after the last. With one, it is typed once.

props.name: cursor
props.description: Show a blinking caret after the text.

props.name: paused
props.description: Stops where it is.

name: UpdatePrompt
summary: The card that says a new version is waiting.

props.name: dismissLabel
props.description: The X's accessible name. An X on its own has none.
